method: FOREX F6 dual-horizon forced blind. Every valid pair is forced BUY/SELL. Before future candles, each setup is classified as IMPULSE_3H or REGIME_24H from relative 6h impulse versus H4/H1 + 24h/72h regime strength. The two horizons are not averaged. SL, TP, expiry and pending-order lifetime are matched to the selected horizon. Minimal indicator stack unchanged. LIMIT is evaluated but MARKET remains default for impulse. No historical macro reconstruction.
